svg.title: The four patterns of the course along the autonomy scale. Reflection (module 2): the AI reviews its own work. Tool use (module 3): the AI decides which tools to call. In both, the programmer still sets the steps. Planning (module 5): the AI writes the steps. Multi-agent (module 5): several AIs, each with a role. These hand more control to the AI.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
